newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 8.5 pct vs. year ago - EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 8.5 pct vs. year ago - EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 62,142 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended Nov 23, up 8.5 percent from the same period in 1995, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said Tuesday.
The amount of power supplied to the South Central area rose the most from a year ago, up 12.4 percent to 7,691 GWh, the EEI said.
Year-to-date domestic power production totaled about 2.99 million GWh, up 2.4 percent from the same period in 1995, EEI said.
